description: K₂Na₂Sm₄Ta₂O₁₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. K is bonded in a 10-coordinate geometry to ten O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.83-3.31 Å. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent TaO₅ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent SmO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.34 Å. There are two inequivalent Sm sites. In the first Sm site, Sm is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted SmO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one SmO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  an edgeedge with one SmO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent TaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.47 Å. In the second Sm site, Sm is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Sm-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.59 Å. Ta is bonded to five O atoms to form TaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids and edges with two equivalent SmO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Ta-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.00 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, two Sm, and one Ta atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, two Sm, and one Ta atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, two Sm, and one Ta atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent K, one Na, and one Ta atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Sm atoms to form OSm₄ tetrahedra that share corners with eight ONaSm₂Ta tetrahedra and edges with two equivalent OSm₄ tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Sm, and one Ta atom to form corner-sharing ONaSm₂Ta tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to four Sm atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OSm₄ tetrahedra.
